name: ARCHIVED_NYPD Shooting Incident Data (Historic)
description:
This dataset is an archived sample of historic shooting incident records from the New York City Police Department, containing 5,000 rows and 21 columns. Each row represents a single shooting incident and includes the date and time it occurred, the borough, precinct, jurisdiction code, and descriptive fields about the location type and classification. It also records whether the incident was flagged as a statistical murder, along with demographic details for the perpetrator and victim, including age group, sex, and race. Geographic fields provide x and y coordinates, latitude and longitude, and a geocoded location value.

The data could be used to analyze patterns in shooting incidents over time and across boroughs or precincts, examine demographic characteristics of victims and perpetrators, map incident locations, or study the relationship between location type and incident outcomes. Because it is an archived historic sample, it is best suited for exploratory analysis, trend research, and teaching or demonstration purposes rather than current operational use.
